properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 24 at 6:03PM EDT until October 25 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Portions of central, northeast, and northern Maryland and
northern Virginia.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
